subtitle_id: Arsitektur Terpadu: Deep Learning BiLSTM+Attention, Kuantitatif MPT, Multi-Agent Copilot & Microservices
subtitle_en: Unified Architecture: BiLSTM+Attention Deep Learning, Quantitative MPT, Multi-Agent Copilot & Microservices
description_id: Arsitektur produksi terpadu yang menyatukan klasifikasi tren jangka pendek IHSG & LQ45 berbasis BiLSTM + Multi-Head Attention (akurasi blind test 94.46%), alokasi modal optimal Modern Portfolio Theory (SciPy SLSQP), dan agen otonom analisis sentimen pasar ke dalam platform microservice FastAPI, React 19, dan Google Gemini API.
description_en: Unified production architecture combining short-term IHSG & LQ45 trend classification via BiLSTM + Multi-Head Attention (94.46% blind test accuracy), Modern Portfolio Theory capital allocation (SciPy SLSQP), and autonomous market sentiment agents into a distributed FastAPI, React 19, and Google Gemini API platform.

blueprint.function_id: Input nominal modal, profil risiko, dan ticker saham LQ45/IDX30 -> Scraper yfinance (dynamic header spoofing) + BI Rate -> Ekstraksi 11 Indikator Teknikal (15-day window) -> BiLSTM + Multi-Head Attention Classifier + SciPy SLSQP Portfolio Optimizer + Multi-Agent Gemini Synthesis -> Output sinyal tren 3-kelas, alokasi Rupiah per saham, dan analisis risiko di Supabase.
blueprint.function_en: Capital input, risk profile, and LQ45/IDX30 tickers -> yfinance Scraper (header spoofing) + Central Bank Rate -> 11 Technical Indicators (15-day window) -> BiLSTM + Multi-Head Attention Classifier + SciPy SLSQP Optimizer + Multi-Agent Gemini Synthesis -> 3-class trend signal, exact capital weights, and risk thesis persisted in Supabase.
blueprint.utility_id: Memangkas waktu riset teknikal dan perhitungan pembagian porsi modal (position sizing) dari 2-3 jam analisis spreadsheet manual menjadi kurang dari 4 detik, membantu investor ritel menghindari keputusan beli impulsif (FOMO).
blueprint.utility_en: Cuts manual technical charting and quantitative position-sizing calculations from 2-3 hours of spreadsheet work to under 4 seconds, helping retail investors avoid impulsive FOMO trades.
blueprint.target_id: Investor ritel pasar modal Indonesia (fokus saham blue-chip LQ45 & IDX30), analis riset ekuitas junior, dan peserta edukasi pasar modal.
blueprint.target_en: Indonesian retail equity investors (focusing on LQ45 & IDX30 blue-chip stocks), junior equity analysts, and capital market learners.
layman_proof_id: Sinyal Cuaca Pasar 3-Warna: Menampilkan status tegas Bullish (Naik), Sideways (Stabil), atau Bearish (Turun) beserta persentase keyakinan model tanpa perlu membaca grafik indikator rumit.
Simulasi Pembagian Rupiah Otomatis: Masukkan modal (misal Rp 10.000.000), sistem otomatis memecah nominal Rupiah ke tiap saham sesuai profil risiko (total terverifikasi 100%).
Alasan Transparan (Explainable AI): Setiap porsi saham disertai penjelasan bahasa manusia mengapa saham tersebut mendapat bobot terbesar berdasarkan tren 15 hari terakhir dan volatilitas historis.
layman_proof_en: 3-State Traffic-Light Signal: Displays clear Bullish, Sideways, or Bearish verdicts with model confidence scores so users do not have to decipher complex indicator charts.
Exact Capital Split Simulation: Enter any capital amount (e.g., IDR 10,000,000) and immediately see the exact currency allocation per stock tailored to your risk profile (verified 100% sum).
Plain-Language Rationale: Every stock weight includes a clear explanation of why it received its allocation based on 15-day momentum and historical volatility.

eval_metrics.secondary: Validated via SciPy Paired t-Test (5Y Data)

architecture_id:
1. Deep Learning Time-Series Engine (BiLSTM + Multi-Head Attention)

  • Model Emiten Individu (LQ45/IDX30): Arsitektur Bidirectional LSTM + Multi-Head Attention pada jendela sekuensial 15 hari x 11 indikator teknikal. Mencapai 94.46% Blind Test Accuracy dan 93% Macro F1-Score (smartinvest_best_model_3class.keras.zip).
  • Model Indeks Makro IHSG: Mencapai 92.64% Blind Test Accuracy dan 90.39% Macro F1-Score (F1 kelas Sideways: 80.00%, ihsg_best_model_3class.keras).

2. Quantitative Portfolio Optimization (Data Science)

  • Algoritma: Mean-Variance Efficient Portfolio (MVEP) via SciPy SLSQP untuk memaksimalkan Sharpe Ratio, Single Index Model (SIM), dan CAPM berbasis sensitivitas Beta pada distribusi return 5 tahun.
  • Validasi Statistik: Uji statistik berpasangan (paired t-test) via SciPy untuk menjamin konsistensi formula kuantitatif.

3. Multi-Agent Financial Copilot & Fullstack Microservices

  • Autonomous Agents: News Sentiment Scraper Agent, Technical Indicator Calculator Agent, dan Portfolio Synthesizer Agent (FastAPI + Google Gemini API).
  • Orkestrasi Platform: React 19 + Tailwind CSS frontend, Node.js Express Gateway, FastAPI Microservices, real-time BI Rate scraper, dan penyimpanan otomatis Supabase (PostgreSQL) dengan kebijakan rotasi 20-record FIFO.
architecture_en:
1. Deep Learning Time-Series Engine (BiLSTM + Multi-Head Attention)

  • Individual Stock Model (LQ45/IDX30): Bidirectional LSTM + Multi-Head Attention over a 15-day sequential window x 11 technical indicators. Achieves 94.46% Blind Test Accuracy and 93% Macro F1-Score (smartinvest_best_model_3class.keras.zip).
  • IHSG Macro Index Model: Achieves 92.64% Blind Test Accuracy and 90.39% Macro F1-Score (Sideways F1: 80.00%, ihsg_best_model_3class.keras).

2. Quantitative Portfolio Optimization (Data Science)

  • Algorithms: Mean-Variance Efficient Portfolio (MVEP) via SciPy SLSQP maximizing Sharpe Ratio, Single Index Model (SIM), and defensive Beta-based CAPM over 5-year historical return distributions.
  • Statistical Validation: Relational paired t-test validation via SciPy guaranteeing formula consistency.

3. Multi-Agent Financial Copilot & Fullstack Microservices

  • Autonomous Agents: News Sentiment Scraper Agent, Technical Indicator Calculator Agent, and Portfolio Synthesizer Agent (FastAPI + Google Gemini API).
  • Platform Orchestration: React 19 + Tailwind CSS client, Node.js Express Gateway, FastAPI Microservices, live Central Bank (BI Rate) scraper, and Supabase (PostgreSQL) persistence with 20-record FIFO rotation.

subtitle_id: Sistem RAG End-to-End dengan Hybrid Retrieval (RRF + pgvector), Sitasi Terverifikasi & Safe Refusal
subtitle_en: End-to-End Indonesian RAG Copilot with Hybrid Retrieval, Verified Citations & Safe Refusal
description_id: Sistem Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) end-to-end berbahasa Indonesia tingkat enterprise untuk pencarian dan pemahaman kebijakan internal perusahaan. Menggabungkan hybrid semantic vector similarity (pgvector) dan keyword search (PostgreSQL FTS) dengan Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), penolakan aman (safe refusal) berbasis threshold bukti, evaluasi terukur (Golden Eval Suite 50 kasus), serta tracing latensi dan token LLMOps.
description_en: Enterprise-grade end-to-end Indonesian Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for internal company policy querying. Features hybrid semantic search (pgvector) fused with PostgreSQL full-text keyword search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), threshold-based safe refusal against out-of-scope hallucinations, a 50-test golden evaluation suite, and production LLMOps telemetry.

blueprint.function_id: Pertanyaan bahasa Indonesia -> Query Normalization -> Hybrid Search (pgvector Cosine HNSW + PostgreSQL Indonesian FTS) -> Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) -> Confidence Threshold Gate -> Google Gemini API Grounded Generation dengan sitasi nomor pasal & tautan PDF asli.
blueprint.function_en: Indonesian policy query -> Query Normalization -> Hybrid Search (pgvector Cosine HNSW + PostgreSQL Indonesian FTS) -> Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) -> Confidence Threshold Gate -> Google Gemini API Grounded Generation with inline clause citations & source PDF preview.
blueprint.utility_id: Mempercepat pencarian aturan HR, Legal, dan SOP internal dari rata-rata 15-20 menit membaca PDF manual menjadi kurang dari 3 detik, sekaligus mengeliminasi risiko salah tafsir kebijakan akibat halusinasi LLM.
blueprint.utility_en: Reduces internal HR, Legal, and SOP document lookup time from 15-20 minutes of manual PDF reading to under 3 seconds while eliminating compliance risks caused by ungrounded LLM hallucinations.
blueprint.target_id: Divisi HR, Legal & Compliance, serta karyawan perusahaan menengah-besar di Indonesia yang memiliki ratusan dokumen PKB/SOP.
blueprint.target_en: HR teams, Legal & Compliance officers, and employees at Indonesian enterprises managing hundreds of internal SOP and regulatory documents.
layman_proof_id: Klik Sitasi Langsung ke PDF: Setiap klaim jawaban memiliki lencana sitasi (misal: Pasal 14 Ayat 2) yang membuka dokumen PDF asli tepat di halaman sumber.
Uji Jebakan Anti-Halusinasi (Safe Refusal): Jika ditanya hal di luar dokumen perusahaan, sistem menolak menjawab secara tegas dan sopan, bukan mengarang jawaban.
Transparansi Skor Bukti: Pengguna dapat melihat potongan teks asli (retrieved chunks) yang menjadi dasar jawaban AI.
layman_proof_en: One-Click PDF Citation Verification: Every answer sentence includes a clause badge (e.g., Article 14 Clause 2) that opens the authentic source PDF page directly.
Out-of-Scope Trap Test (Safe Refusal): When asked questions outside the uploaded policy corpus, the system deterministically refuses to answer rather than fabricating rules.
Evidence Transparency Drawer: Users can inspect the exact retrieved paragraphs and relevance scores behind every response.

eval_metrics.secondary: Exact clause & acronym matching solved via FTS
Tracks latency (ms), token count, and citation hits

architecture_id:
1. Hybrid Retrieval Engine (RRF + pgvector + PostgreSQL FTS)

  • Vector Similarity: Embedding semantik disimpan dalam PostgreSQL 16 dengan ekstensi pgvector menggunakan cosine distance HNSW index.
  • Keyword Search: PostgreSQL Full-Text Search (FTS) berbahasa Indonesia untuk matching akurat nomor pasal, singkatan, dan regulasi spesifik.
  • Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF): Menggabungkan hasil ranking semantik dan keyword dengan bobot adaptif untuk menghasilkan context recall optimal (Recall@5 mencapai 98%).

2. Grounded Generation, Citations & Safe Refusal

  • Strict Citations: Setiap jawaban LLM wajib menyertakan sitasi dokumen sumber spesifik hingga ke nomor pasal/paragraf.
  • Safe Refusal Mechanism: Sistem menghitung threshold confidence bukti retrieval; jika bukti di bawah ambang batas, model secara otomatis menolak menjawab alih-alih berhalusinasi.
  • PDF Verifiable Source: Endpoint PDF terproteksi yang memungkinkan pengguna langsung memverifikasi dokumen rujukan asli dari UI.

3. Golden Evaluation Suite & LLMOps Telemetry

  • Evaluation Benchmark: 50 golden test cases mencakup skenario factual, multi-policy reasoning, ambiguity, safe refusal, dan adversarial queries.
  • Tracing & Monitoring: Telemetri menyeluruh mencakup tracking latensi inferensi, konsumsi token, model routing, serta umpan balik pengguna tersimpan di PostgreSQL.
  • Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL 16, pgvector, Docker, 9Router LLM Gateway.
architecture_en:
1. Hybrid Retrieval Engine (RRF + pgvector + PostgreSQL FTS)

  • Vector Similarity: Semantic embeddings stored in PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector extension utilizing cosine distance HNSW indexing.
  • Keyword Search: Indonesian PostgreSQL Full-Text Search (FTS) for precise matching of specific clauses, abbreviations, and regulatory numbers.
  • Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF): Fuses dense vector and sparse keyword rankings with adaptive weighting for optimal context recall (Recall@5 reaches 98%).

2. Grounded Generation, Citations & Safe Refusal

  • Strict Citations: Every LLM generation is strictly grounded and includes exact source document, section, and article references.
  • Safe Refusal Mechanism: System evaluates retrieval confidence thresholds; when evidence falls below safety margins, the model refuses gracefully instead of hallucinating.
  • PDF Verifiable Source: Protected PDF endpoint enabling users to inspect and verify authentic referenced documents directly in the UI.

3. Golden Evaluation Suite & LLMOps Telemetry

  • Evaluation Benchmark: 50 golden test cases covering factual queries, multi-policy synthesis, ambiguity, safe refusal, and adversarial prompts.
  • Tracing & Monitoring: Complete telemetry logging inference latencies, token expenditures, model fallback routing, and user feedback into PostgreSQL.
  • Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL 16, pgvector, Docker, 9Router LLM Gateway.

description_id: Aplikasi deteksi gambar untuk membedakan sampah Organik dan Anorganik secara otomatis. Bertujuan membantu digitalisasi pengelolaan sampah rumah tangga dan instansi.
description_en: Image detection application to automatically classify Organic and Inorganic waste, designed to support waste management digitization in households and institutions.

blueprint.function_id: Stream Kamera WebRTC / Unggahan Citra -> Preprocessing & Normalisasi Tensor (224x224 RGB) -> Fine-Tuned EfficientNetV2 CNN Backbone -> FastAPI REST Inference Container (Docker) -> Output Kelas Sampah (Organik/Anorganik) + Skor Keyakinan + Rekomendasi Penanganan.
blueprint.function_en: WebRTC Camera Stream / Image Upload -> Tensor Preprocessing & Normalization (224x224 RGB) -> Fine-Tuned EfficientNetV2 CNN Backbone -> Dockerized FastAPI Inference Container -> Waste Category (Organic/Inorganic) + Confidence Score + Disposal Guide.
blueprint.utility_id: Mengurangi kesalahan pemilahan sampah di sumber rumah tangga dan fasilitas publik tanpa memerlukan perangkat keras sensor mahal, cukup menggunakan kamera smartphone atau webcam standar.
blueprint.utility_en: Reduces waste sorting errors at household and institutional collection points without expensive sensor hardware, operating directly on standard smartphone or webcam cameras.
blueprint.target_id: Bank sampah digital, fasilitas pengelolaan limbah kampus/instansi, dan edukasi pemilahan sampah masyarakat.
blueprint.target_en: Digital waste banks, campus/institutional recycling facilities, and public waste management programs.
layman_proof_id: Uji Kamera Langsung (Live Camera): Arahkan kamera HP/laptop ke benda di sekitar (misal botol plastik atau sisa daun), sistem langsung menampilkan label Organik/Anorganik dalam hitungan milidetik.
Indikator Persentase Keyakinan: Menampilkan angka probabilitas yang jelas (misal: 98.4% Anorganik) sehingga pengguna tahu seberapa yakin model terhadap gambar tersebut.
Pemisahan Arsitektur Backend & UI: Antarmuka web di Vercel berkomunikasi langsung dengan container API produksi di Hugging Face Spaces.
layman_proof_en: Instant Live Camera Test: Point any phone or laptop webcam at a plastic bottle or organic item and see the classification badge appear in real time.
Confidence Percentage Meter: Displays transparent probability scores (e.g., 98.4% Inorganic) alongside practical disposal instructions.
Decoupled Cloud Deployment: Responsive React frontend on Vercel communicating with a containerized FastAPI inference engine on Hugging Face Spaces.

description_id: Aplikasi developer tool untuk merancang, menguji, dan membandingkan variasi prompt LLM sistematis. Membantu AI Engineer menguji ketahanan role-prompting, few-shot examples, token efficiency, dan edge-case refusal sebelum model dideploy ke produksi.
description_en: Developer workbench application designed to formulate, test, and benchmark LLM prompt variations. Enables AI Engineers to systematically validate system prompt guardrails, few-shot distributions, token usage, and edge-case behaviors before deployment.

blueprint.function_id: Variasi System Prompt A & B + Variabel Template Dinamis + Test Input -> Eksekusi Paralel LLM API -> Komparasi Output Berdampingan + Kalkulasi Konsumsi Token & Estimasi Biaya.
blueprint.function_en: System Prompt Variants A & B + Dynamic Template Variables + Test Inputs -> Parallel LLM API Execution -> Side-by-Side Output Diffing + Token & Cost Profiling.
blueprint.utility_id: Menggantikan proses coba-coba prompt secara acak di chat biasa dengan pengujian A/B yang terstruktur dan terukur, menghemat waktu iterasi prompt engineering sekaligus memangkas pemborosan token.
blueprint.utility_en: Replaces ad-hoc prompt trial-and-error with structured side-by-side A/B testing, accelerating prompt engineering iterations while reducing unnecessary token usage.
blueprint.target_id: AI Engineer, LLM Application Developer, dan Prompt Engineer yang membangun fitur berbasis Google Gemini API / OpenAI SDK.
blueprint.target_en: AI Engineers, LLM Application Developers, and Prompt Engineers building production features on Google Gemini API or OpenAI-compatible SDKs.
layman_proof_id: Layar Uji Banding Berdampingan (A vs B): Pengguna langsung melihat bagaimana perubahan 1 kalimat instruksi mengubah kualitas dan kerapian jawaban AI pada layar kiri vs kanan.
Kalkulator Token & Biaya Otomatis: Menampilkan jumlah token secara langsung sehingga mudah memahami prompt mana yang lebih hemat biaya.
layman_proof_en: Side-by-Side A/B Comparison View: Immediately see how changing a single constraint alters response quality and structure across Variant A and Variant B.
Live Token & Cost Meter: Displays real-time token counts so anyone can verify which prompt achieves the goal with lower cost.

  • Template Engine: Variabel dinamis untuk penyusunan prompt terstruktur.
architecture_en:
1. Workbench Capabilities

  • Side-by-side Comparison: Parallel comparison of prompt variants against uniform test inputs.

subtitle_id: Klasifikasi Tren IHSG & Saham dengan Deep Learning (BiLSTM + Attention)
subtitle_en: IHSG & Stock Market Trend Classification with Deep Learning (BiLSTM + Attention)
description_id: Modul Deep Learning time-series berkinerja tinggi untuk memprediksi pergerakan jangka pendek (Naik/Bullish, Stabil/Sideways, Turun/Bearish) pada indeks pasar IHSG dan emiten individu konstituen LQ45/IDX30.
description_en: High-performance time-series Deep Learning module designed to classify short-term movement trends (Bullish, Sideways, Bearish) for the IHSG composite index and individual LQ45/IDX30 stocks.
architecture_id:
1. Model Rekomendasi IHSG (Tren Pasar Makro)

  • Arsitektur: Bidirectional LSTM + Multi-Head Attention + Custom Dense layers.
  • Input: Data sekuensial 15 hari perdagangan dengan 11 fitur indikator teknikal (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, dll.).
  • Akurasi & Performa: Uji Blind Test menghasilkan Akurasi 92.64% dan Macro F1-Score 90.39% (F1-Score Sideways mencapai 80.00%).
  • Berkas Model: ihsg_best_model_3class.keras
  • Jupyter Notebook: KLASIFIKASI_IHSG_TUNED_DAN_REKOMENDASI.ipynb

2. Model Analisis Emiten (Saham Individual LQ45/IDX30)

  • Arsitektur: Bidirectional LSTM + Multi-Head Attention + Custom Dense layers (dengan fine-tuning parameter emiten).
  • Input: Data sekuensial 15 hari perdagangan dengan 11 fitur indikator teknikal.
  • Akurasi & Performa: Uji Blind Test menghasilkan Akurasi 94.46% dan Macro F1-Score 93%.
  • Berkas Model: smartinvest_best_model_3class.keras.zip
  • Jupyter Notebook: Modelling_trenSaham_FIXED_STABIL.ipynb

3. Sistem Deployment & Scraping Pipeline

  • Deployment: FastAPI microservices untuk menyajikan prediksi real-time secara terdistribusi.
  • Rate-Limiting Bypass: Yahoo Finance scraper dengan browser header spoofing dinamis untuk menghindari rate-limiting API.
architecture_en:
1. IHSG Recommendation Model (Macro Market Trend)

  • Architecture: Bidirectional LSTM + Multi-Head Attention + Custom Dense layers.
  • Input: Sequential 15-day trading data with 11 technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, etc.).
  • Accuracy & Performance: Blind Test achieves 92.64% Accuracy and 90.39% Macro F1-Score (Sideways F1-Score: 80.00%).
  • Model File: ihsg_best_model_3class.keras
  • Jupyter Notebook: KLASIFIKASI_IHSG_TUNED_DAN_REKOMENDASI.ipynb

2. Individual Stock Analysis Model (LQ45/IDX30 Stocks)

  • Architecture: Bidirectional LSTM + Multi-Head Attention + Custom Dense layers (tuned for stock variance).
  • Input: Sequential 15-day trading data with 11 technical indicators.
  • Accuracy & Performance: Blind Test achieves 94.46% Accuracy and 93% Macro F1-Score.
  • Model File: smartinvest_best_model_3class.keras.zip
  • Jupyter Notebook: Modelling_trenSaham_FIXED_STABIL.ipynb

3. Deployment & Scraping Pipeline

  • Deployment: Distributed FastAPI microservices serving predictions in real-time.
  • Rate-Limiting Bypass: Yahoo Finance scraper with dynamic browser header spoofing to circumvent API rate-limits.

subtitle_id: Sistem Multi-Agent Otonom untuk Analisis Finansial, Sentimen Pasar & Portofolio

description_id: Arsitektur multi-agent otonom yang memecah riset investasi kompleks ke dalam beberapa agent terspesialisasi: News Sentiment Scraper Agent, Technical Indicator Calculator Agent, dan Portfolio Advisory Agent. Dibangun dengan backend Python FastAPI dan UI TypeScript interaktif.
description_en: Autonomous multi-agent architecture decomposing complex financial research into specialized cooperating agents: News Sentiment Scraper, Technical Indicator Calculator, and Portfolio Advisor Agent. Built with Python FastAPI backend and responsive TypeScript UI.
architecture_id:
1. Sistem Multi-Agent Orchestration

  • Research Agent: Scrape berita emiten IDX real-time dan analisis sentimen berita.
  • Technical Agent: Menghitung moving averages, RSI, MACD, dan sinyal breakout.
  • Synthesizer Agent: Menggabungkan hasil analisis multi-agent menjadi rekomendasi portofolio terstruktur.

2. Microservices Architecture

  • Backend (BE): Python FastAPI dengan asynchronous agent task queue.
  • Frontend (UI): TypeScript modern chat & card interface untuk interaksi dinamis pengguna.
architecture_en:
1. Multi-Agent Orchestration

  • Research Agent: Real-time IDX corporate news scraping and NLP sentiment analysis.
  • Technical Agent: Computes moving averages, momentum indicators (RSI, MACD), and breakout signals.
  • Synthesizer Agent: Fuses multi-agent findings into a cohesive, structured portfolio thesis.

2. Microservices Architecture

  • Backend: Python FastAPI with asynchronous execution and structured agent outputs.
  • Frontend: TypeScript modern responsive dashboard for agent step inspection.

description_id: Modul riset kuantitatif dan analisis data keuangan yang mengalokasikan bobot modal optimal untuk meminimalkan risiko portofolio saham berdasarkan profil risiko investor.
description_en: Quantitative financial research module allocating optimal asset weights to minimize portfolio risk based on investor profiles.
architecture_id:
• Algoritma Utama: MVEP (Mean-Variance Efficient Portfolio) via SciPy SLSQP optimizer untuk memaksimalkan Sharpe Ratio, SIM (Single Index Model) untuk menyederhanakan kovarians pasar, dan CAPM (Capital Asset Pricing Model) untuk portofolio defensif berbasis sensitivitas Beta.
• Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Analisis return historis 5 tahun emiten LQ45/IDX30, visualisasi Correlation Heatmap, Risk vs Return Scatter Plot, dan Rolling Volatility.
• Analisis Statistik: Uji statistik berpasangan t-test relasional via SciPy untuk menjamin konsistensi formula kuantitatif.
• Jupyter Notebooks: notebook.ipynb & AB_Testing_Capstone_Project.ipynb.
• Validasi Dasbor: Prototipe interaktif divalidasi via Streamlit sebelum integrasi ke web produksi.
architecture_en:
• Core Algorithms: MVEP (Mean-Variance Efficient Portfolio) via SciPy SLSQP solver to maximize Sharpe Ratio, SIM (Single Index Model) to simplify market covariance, and CAPM (Capital Asset Pricing Model) for defensive Beta-based allocations.
• Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Analyzed 5-year historical return distributions of LQ45/IDX30 stocks, plotting Correlation Heatmaps, Risk vs. Return Scatters, and Rolling Volatility.
• Statistical Analysis: Relational t-test statistical validation via SciPy to guarantee mathematical formula consistency.

title_id: Benchmark Ekstraksi Fitur SIFT vs AKAZE
title_en: SIFT vs AKAZE Feature Extraction Benchmark
subtitle_id: Studi Komparasi Algoritma Computer Vision pada Dataset Wajah NIST
subtitle_en: Comparative Computer Vision Study on NIST Facial Dataset
description_id: Penelitian dan benchmarking komparatif antara algoritma Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) dan Accelerated-KAZE (AKAZE) untuk ekstraksi fitur citra wajah menggunakan NIST dataset. Mengevaluasi densitas keypoint, invariance terhadap rotasi dan skala, kecepatan komputasi, serta efisiensi feature matching.
description_en: Comparative research and benchmarking between Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) and Accelerated-KAZE (AKAZE) algorithms for facial image feature extraction on the NIST dataset. Analyzes keypoint density, rotation/scale invariance, execution speed, and matching accuracy.
architecture_id:
1. Pipeline Ekstraksi Fitur

  • Preprocessing: Grayscale conversion, adaptive histogram equalization, dan normalisasi dimensi citra wajah NIST.
  • SIFT: DoG (Difference of Gaussians) scale space extrema detection dan gradient orientation assignment.
  • AKAZE: Non-linear scale space filtering menggunakan Fast Explicit Diffusion (FED) dan descriptor binary M-LDB.

2. Evaluasi Komparatif & Output

  • Feature Matching: FLANN based matcher untuk SIFT dan Brute-Force Hamming matcher untuk AKAZE.
  • Laporan Analitis: Visualisasi komparasi grafik keypoints, ekspor data matriks ke format Excel dan Word.
architecture_en:
1. Feature Extraction Pipeline

  • Preprocessing: Grayscale normalization, adaptive histogram equalization, and dimension scaling on NIST facial dataset.
  • SIFT: Difference of Gaussians (DoG) scale space extrema detection and gradient orientation assignment.
  • AKAZE: Non-linear scale space filtering using Fast Explicit Diffusion (FED) and M-LDB binary descriptors.

2. Comparative Evaluation & Outputs

  • Feature Matching: FLANN based matcher for SIFT and Brute-Force Hamming matcher for AKAZE.
  • Analytical Reports: Keypoint distribution plotting, execution timing comparisons, and exported Excel/Word reports.

subtitle_id: Model Klasifikasi Multi-Kelas Menggunakan Arsitektur Convolutional Neural Network
subtitle_en: Multi-Class Deep CNN Model with Augmentation & Confusion Matrix Analysis
description_id: Model Computer Vision Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) kustom untuk klasifikasi citra 5 kelas identifikasi subjek. Mengimplementasikan augmentasi data citra, regularisasi dropout, categorical cross-entropy loss, dan evaluasi matriks performa komprehensif.
description_en: Custom Computer Vision Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model for 5-class object/subject identification. Implements image augmentation pipelines, dropout regularization, categorical cross-entropy optimization, and confusion matrix performance evaluation.
architecture_id:
1. Arsitektur Convolutional

  • Feature Extractor: Multiple stacked Conv2D layers (32, 64, 128 filters) dengan ReLU activation dan MaxPooling2D.
  • Regularisasi: Batch Normalization dan Dropout (0.3 - 0.5) untuk mencegah overfitting pada dataset citra terbatas.
  • Dense Classifier: Flatten layer diteruskan ke Dense 256 dan output layer Softmax 5 kelas.

2. Pipeline Pelatihan & Evaluasi

  • Augmentasi: Random rotation, zoom, width/height shift, dan horizontal flip menggunakan ImageDataGenerator.
  • Optimasi: Adam optimizer dengan learning rate schedule adaptif.
architecture_en:
1. Convolutional Architecture

  • Feature Extractor: Stacked Conv2D layers (32, 64, 128 filters) with ReLU activations and MaxPooling2D layers.
  • Regularization: Batch Normalization and Dropout (0.3 - 0.5) to combat overfitting on custom image datasets.
  • Dense Classifier: Flattened feature representations routed to Dense 256 and 5-class Softmax output layer.

2. Training Pipeline & Evaluation

  • Data Augmentation: Random rotation, zoom, translation shifts, and horizontal flips via ImageDataGenerator.
  • Optimization: Adam optimizer with adaptive learning rate scheduling and early stopping.

architecture_en:
